The BY publisher response is an Incapsula challenge wrapper. The Altman PMC response is a challenge, its BMJ route is 404, and NCBI BioC returns an explicit error page. No challenge was bypassed, and extracted error-page blocks earn no reading credit.
The BH scan has no extractable text layer. Five full native page images were read; no OCR output or appendix-proof reading is claimed.
The portable PPV Python source was syntax-parsed but not executed because Matplotlib and NumPy are absent in this interpreter. No installation or exact-output reproduction is claimed.
Source-specific common count/rate axis constructions are verified in the native art but are only partly represented in canonical text. No image is registered in the graph.
